summary: P3b Platform Owner Portal verified end-to-end. Backend: 81/81 pytest (61 prior regression + 20 new owner-portal tests) — TOTP bypass `000000`, two-step login, KPIs, tenants CRUD, demo detail, create-tenant + auto-seeded Manager PIN 9999 login on `/api/auth/login` with X-Tenant-Slug header, impersonation FULL writeable, impersonation AUDITOR returns 403 on POST /api/customers, missing reason → 400, unknown tenant → 404, unauthorized owner endpoints → 401. UI: login + TOTP 000000 → dashboard with all 4 KPI tiles + demo tenant row, sidebar Tenants list shows 4+ rows, demo detail shows KPIs + staff (Aarav Reddy), Create Tenant form provisions tenant. UI impersonation has ONE high-priority bug — modal navigates via React Router only (no full reload), so PosContext (already mounted) never re-reads the swapped JWT and Protected gate bounces to /login. Verified the localStorage IS correctly set (pos_token, imp_ctx, owner_backup) and a hard navigation to `/` renders the banner properly with the right colors (Full=#1c1410, Auditor=#321519, text 'Auditing … · read-only'). Exit button + auditor write-block both work.

ui_bugs.issue: After beginImpersonation() the modal calls navigate('/') but PosContext only bootstraps on mount with the OLD token (empty). Result: Protected gate sees staffUser=null and redirects to /login. ImpersonationBanner never renders. localStorage IS correctly populated; a window.location.assign('/') (or location.reload after navigate, mirroring endImpersonation's pattern at ImpersonationBanner line 17) fixes it instantly — verified by manually reloading the page, banner then renders with correct colors and read-only text.

integration_issues.issue: Soft SPA navigation does not re-bootstrap PosContext, so the staff session swap is invisible to React until a hard reload. Backend impersonation token itself is valid (auth.me succeeds when called manually, /api/customers POST returns 200 in full mode and 403 in auditor mode).

action_items: ImpersonateModal.jsx onGo(): after beginImpersonation(...), replace `navigate('/')` with `window.location.assign('/')` (or call navigate('/') then setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 50)). Mirrors the same hard-reload pattern already used in ImpersonationBanner.onExit() — without it, Protected route bounces to /login because PosContext never re-runs auth.me() with the new token.
After the above fix, re-test impersonation FULL and AUDITOR end-to-end through the UI (banner color + text + Exit + writes/blocks).
critical_code_review_comments: PosContext.jsx boot useEffect has deps [loadAll] but the token swap happens via direct localStorage write in beginImpersonation — there is no signal back to React. Either move bootstrap to depend on a `tokenVersion` state that beginImpersonation bumps, OR do a hard reload on impersonation begin (simplest + already the convention on exit).
owner_routes.py:281 impersonate_tenant picks the FIRST seeded Manager (no selector). Fine for single-Manager tenants but should fail-fast if multiple Managers exist or accept a target user_id.

owner_routes.py:316 /me/totp-qr returns the owner's TOTP secret URI to anyone with an owner JWT — acceptable since owner is already authenticated, but consider gating behind a fresh-password challenge before exposing the secret again.
tenants.py X-Tenant-Slug resolution: header name is `X-Tenant-Slug`, NOT `X-Tenant` (docs/credentials file did not mention this; I had to correct my pytest fixture).
ownerClient.js beginImpersonation does set staffTokenStore + staffTenantStore + impersonationCtx but offers no callback/event for React contexts to re-read — see ImpersonateModal bug above.
OwnerTotp.jsx fix verified — no longer bounces back to /owner/login after successful verify.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (login + TOTP + dashboard + KPIs + tenants list + tenant detail + create tenant + exit impersonation + logout all pass; impersonation-begin UI hand-off is broken by SPA navigation, banner only appears after a hard reload)

test_credentials: Owner email owner@kanda.app / password OwnerPass#2025 / TOTP 000000 (test bypass). New tenants seeded with Manager PIN 9999 in tests — auth via POST /api/auth/login with header X-Tenant-Slug: <slug>.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates ~1 new tenant `qatest<NNNNN>` (with Manager 'QA Manager' PIN 9999), ~2 impersonation audit rows in owner_impersonations, and 1 TEST_ImpFull customer on the demo tenant. Old qatest tenants accumulate — main agent may want to add a cleanup pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v` to confirm 81/81 pass. For UI re-test of the impersonation fix, open /owner/login, complete login+TOTP 000000, click demo tenant row → Impersonate → confirm; URL should land on `/` (NOT `/login`) and `[data-testid='impersonation-banner']` should be visible. RCA proven: localStorage is set correctly post-impersonate but PosContext never re-runs auth.me() — fix needs a hard reload, mirroring ImpersonationBanner.onExit.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE — ImpersonateModal.onGo calls `beginImpersonation(...)` which writes `kanda_pos_token_v1`, `kanda_pos_tenant_slug` and `kanda_owner_impersonation_ctx_v1` to localStorage, then calls `navigate('/')`. PosContext was already mounted at /owner with no staff token; its boot useEffect (line 44, deps [loadAll]) ran exactly once with an empty token and set bootState='ready', staffUser=null. React Router's SPA navigation does NOT remount PosContext, so the new token is never seen. The Protected gate at App.js:34 reads staffUser=null and redirects to /login. REPRODUCTION — Login as owner, open Demo tenant, click Impersonate, click Open Demo Restaurant. Observed URL: `/login` (Staff Sign In). Expected: `/` with the orange Impersonating banner at the top. MITIGATION — In ImpersonateModal.jsx replace `navigate('/')` with `window.location.assign('/')` so PosContext bootstraps fresh. Verified manually: navigating to `/` after a full reload renders the Full banner (bg #1c1410, text 'Impersonating Demo Restaurant') and the Auditor banner (bg #321519, text 'Auditing Demo Restaurant · read-only') correctly. Auditor backend write-block also confirmed (POST /api/customers → 403 with impersonation token, GET /api/menu/items → 200).
